ACAccount.doc: The information associated with one of the user’s accounts.

ACAccountCredential.doc: A credential object that encapsulates the information needed to authenticate a user.

ACAccountStore.doc: The object you use to request, manage, and store the user’s account information.

ACAccountType.doc: An object that encapsulates information about all accounts of a particular type.

ACAccountCredentialRenewResult.doc: Status codes of credential renewal requests.

ACAccountCredentialRenewResultFailed.doc: A non-user-initiated cancel of the prompt.

ACAccountCredentialRenewResultRejected.doc: Renewal failed because the user revoked your access to their account.

ACAccountCredentialRenewResultRenewed.doc: The account’s credentials have been renewed and are now associated with the account.

ACErrorCode.doc: Codes for errors that may occur.

init(_:).doc: Initializes a new error code structure.

init(rawValue:).doc: Initializes a new error code structure.

rawValue.doc: The raw integer value of the error code.

-initWithAccountType:.doc: Initializes a new account of the specified type.

-initWithOAuth2Token:refreshToken:expiry.doc: Initializes an account credential using OAuth 2.

-initWithOAuthToken:tokenSecret:.doc: Initializes an account credential using OAuth.

-accountTypeWithAccountTypeIdentifier:.doc: Returns an account type that matches the specified identifier.

-accountWithIdentifier:.doc: Returns the account with the specified identifier.

-accountsWithAccountType:.doc: Returns all accounts of the specified type.

-removeAccount:withCompletionHandler:.doc: Removes an account from the account store.

-renewCredentialsForAccount:completion:.doc: Renews account credentials when the credentials are no longer valid.

-requestAccessToAccountsWithType:options.doc: Obtains permission to access protected user properties.

-requestAccessToAccountsWithType:withCom.doc: Requests access to accounts of the specified type.

-saveAccount:withCompletionHandler:.doc: Saves an account to the Accounts database.

accountDescription.doc: A human-readable description of the account.

credential.doc: The credential used to authenticate the user of this account.

identifier.doc: A unique identifier for this account.

userFullName.doc: The full name associated with the user account.

oauthToken.doc: The token used for the credential.

accounts.doc: The accounts managed by this account store.

accessGranted.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether the user granted the application access to accounts of this type.

accountTypeDescription.doc: A human-readable description of the account type.

identifier.doc: The unique identifier for the account type.
